composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, dish centered, the dish and food filling about 75% of the square with even margins (at least 12% on every side). No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the dish floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only under the food inside the dish. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, appetizing colors that are bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the dish
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the dish.
